response.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_rem FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), overall AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS oa FROM orderexecutions), above AS (SELECT o.ordersmark, o.avg_rem, overall.oa FROM o CROSS JOIN overall WHERE o.avg_rem > overall.oa), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rem) AS ga FROM above), final AS (SELECT a.avg_rem, a.oa, g.ga FROM above a CROSS JOIN grp g WHERE a.avg_rem > g.ga) SELECT AVG(avg_rem) AS avg_of_averages, AVG(avg_rem - oa) AS avg_excess_over_overall, AVG(avg_rem - ga) AS avg_excess_over_group_avg FROM final
